name: 46074 · Westfield, IN
findings: ZIP 46074 (Westfield) has 136 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46074 (Westfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
